name: Haute
intent: Higher image quality for lighter games while retaining meaningful headroom below full 4K internal rendering.

reasoning: This is 43.75% less internal pixel work than 2.0x while giving a visibly denser source for 4K output.
Bicubic is used as the sharper conventional scaler when the internal image still needs to reach 2160p.
FXAA remains a low-cost edge cleanup pass.
